topic: Hesitation or stalling under load? It's not always the fuel pump.
negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Hesitating or stalling under load? It's not always the fuel pump.
beats.visualPrompt: Road POV shot, static-mounted dash camera angle, car climbing a gentle grade, engine bay implied through subtle vibration/shake in frame, overcast daylight.

beats.narration: Sluggish on hills, bogging when you merge, or stalling that only shows up under real load.
beats.visualPrompt: Split-style cut: close-up on a tachometer needle dipping/surging under an implied throttle input, then a wide highway-merge-lane shot from a static roadside angle.

beats.narration: A clogged fuel filter can point to fuel starving the engine exactly when it needs more — not at idle, only under demand.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: an inline fuel filter held near a workbench with visible sediment/discoloration inside a clear housing (part visible, no hand in frame), slow push-in; cut to a fuel line routed along an underbody, shop-bay lighting.

beats.narration: Leave it long enough and the fuel pump straining against that clog can wear out early too.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a fuel pump module resting on a shop bench, dim bay lighting, static hold, subtle heat-haze shimmer to suggest thermal strain.

beats.narration: Don't guess — a stall on the highway is the wrong place to find out.
beats.visualPrompt: Empty highway shoulder at dusk, hazard-light glow implied via ambient orange cast, static wide shot, no vehicle or person in frame — mood shot only.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it strands you. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Logo and CTA text composited in post, not AI-generated.

adVariants.hook: Your car hesitates only when you actually need power?
adVariants.caption: That's a load-demand clue, not a random glitch — could be a clogged fuel filter starving the engine right when it needs more.
adVariants.cta: Stop by Nick's Tire & Auto — we'll take a look.

adVariants.hook: Stalling on the highway and assuming it's the fuel pump?
adVariants.caption: Check the filter first — a clogged one strains the pump and can take it down with it. Don't guess before you're stranded.
adVariants.cta: Nick's Tire & Auto — worth checking, no pressure.
